name: ambiguous
requirement: Make link analytics more useful for the marketing team, and make the service more reliable.
constraints:
Existing codebase: url-shortener-service (Java 21, Spring Boot 3.5, Gradle Kotlin DSL, package io.github.hemanthvk980.shortener).
Follow its conventions: layering api → service → repo → domain (enforced by ArchUnit), RFC 7807 errors via common.GlobalExceptionHandler,
configuration via AppProperties. Only modify files under url-shortener-service/. Tests: JUnit 5 + MockMvc in the existing style.

design: CHANGES_REQUESTED: keep the default window at 30 days so existing clients see no change
release-readiness: APPROVED: scope matches the clarified requirement; reliability tracked separately

answers.analytics: Marketing wants to choose the time window for daily stats (between 7 and 90 days) and to see how many distinct sites referred traffic.
answers.reliability: Out of scope for this increment. We will first define SLOs and measure; open a separate ticket. Do not change reliability behaviour now.
